The visible specifications are limited in this view. The page mentions that the X70 Plus is a "crossover SUV" (хүртэл — өөрийн амьдралын хэв маяг тойрхох загварын сонтгоотой) and includes:
- 1.6 Turbo engine (1.6 Турбо хөдөлгүүр)
- 197 horsepower (197 морины хүчтэй)

**Visible Issues:**
There don't appear to be any visible issues with the page itself. The layout is clean and the model information is clearly presented. The page seems to be functioning properly with the navigation menu, model selection tabs, and descriptive text all displaying correctly. The only limitation is that pricing information isn't visible in this particular view of the page.
